Name: Writ Bombardment
Description: You write a line of arcane text that describes projectiles appearing and hurtling towards up to 3 targets you can see within 60 feet. The projectiles fire toward them, and the targets must each make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they each take 4d6 bludgeoning damage, or half as much on a success. Any creature who fails by 5 points or more is sluggish until the end of their next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell at 3rd level or higher you may choose one of the following two options: the spell’s damage increases by 1d6, or choose one additional target within range. You make this choice for each slot level above 2nd.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
